scope: Regular checkpoint-like files from initial find inventory; excludes datasets, other worktrees, vendored repositories, symlinks, environments and paper. Includes pickle/joblib model candidates; extension alone does not prove a model.
method: SHA-256 on bytes; exact relative-path references in text files up to 8 MB, capped at 40 per checkpoint. This is incomplete: dynamic paths, absolute aliases, generic basenames, skipped files and ignored dependencies may not be found. Nearby files are leads, not proof of checkpoint-metric linkage.
policy: All retained pending per-protocol metric and dependency adjudication; duplicate bytes do not prove paths are interchangeable.
